question:
73 Which of the following statements are correct regarding the Unique Land Parcel Identification Number (ULPIN) system?

1. ULPIN assigns a unique ID to every land parcel in India.

2. ULPIN is a 14-digit identification number.

3. ULPIN helps track land ownership and resolve disputes.

4. ULPIN is only for urban areas and not rural land.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) 1, 2, and 3 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Unique Land Parcel Identification Number (ULPIN)** provides a 14-digit alphanumeric ID to uniquely identify every land parcel in India.
 
• ULPIN is designed to improve transparency in land ownership and facilitate seamless integration of land records across states.
 
• The system helps in the resolution of disputes related to land ownership and ensures proper tracking of land transactions.
 
• ULPIN is applicable to both **rural and urban land parcels**, contrary to the incorrect statement that it is only for urban areas.
 
• It is a step towards the digitization of land records under the **Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP):**

 
 
• Launched in 2008, DILRMP aims to digitize and modernize land records to enhance efficiency, transparency, and dispute resolution.
 
• It involves the integration of property registration with land records and cadastral maps.
 
 
 
• **ULPIN Implementation:**
 
 
• ULPIN is being rolled out in a phased manner across Indian states and union territories.
 
• It is expected to be a single source of information for any land parcel, accessible through a centralized database.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of ULPIN:**
 
 
• Reduction in land disputes through accurate identification and ownership tracking.
 
• Improved ease of doing business as it simplifies land-related transactions.
 
• Better targeting and implementation of government schemes linked to land.
 
 
 
• **Land Reforms in India:**
 
 
• Land reforms aim to address issues like land ownership inequality, tenancy regulation, and consolidation of fragmented land holdings.
 
• Digitization initiatives like ULPIN play a key role in modernizing and streamlining land governance.
